latent_truth.description: The resident is a flexible-screen / injection-molding process engineer. Alongside ordinary work logistics (mold iterations, yield, customer audit), one durable fact class recurs eight times over four weeks and never resolves: nocturnal acid reflux that wakes him at night, gets worse after late meals and heavy coffee, produces a hoarse throat by day, and does not respond to self-medication. It is a recurring body-condition signal with a behavioural coupling (late eating, workload-driven coffee), not a single event and not a passing remark. Any correct treatment of this stream must (a) keep it as a separate recurring axis rather than spreading it across work events, and (b) never assert that the reflux causes the yield outcome or vice versa: the evidence only shows co-occurrence.

expected_new_axis.semantic: recurring bodily condition / health signal with its own triggers and progression
expected_new_axis.why_existing_dimensions_are_insufficient: Existing filing axes are source channels (dim:user_ai_interaction, dim:note, dim:calendar, dim:ai_communication_experience). Filing a body-condition signal under a channel loses the axis entirely, and the condition spans both note and conversation channels, so no single channel dimension can host it without splitting it.

anti_leak_rule: Evaluator only. Do not place this file in resident context.
